Corrosion in inner front left pillar. Scratches/dings in inner left B-pillar. Scratch in inner right B-pillar. Oil leaks from front/rear crank seals and timing cover. Signs of removal for valve cover, timing cover, and alternator. Signs of gearbox and engine cooler replacement. Feed systems fully dismantled. Exhaust manifold dismantled. Battery leak. Rust on battery base. Water scaling from elbow joint. Oil leak from turbo intake and lower cooling hose. Door seals cut. Front inner firewall felt cut. Boot felt cut. Door upholstery and console wear/fading. Minor sun visor break. Grease leak from left inner CV joint. Severe undercarriage floor hits. Broken under-engine shield, left sill shield, front right inner fender, and rear inner fenders. Minor front subframe hit. Leather upholstery installed.
